data.title: bn-73w: M0.7.5 Re-cut the M1 bones against the frozen contracts and the M0 decision

data.body: [P1] Validate the tracker projection, not only this manifest. The gate compares keep_bones and acceptance_routes to constants in the same script and then checks repository contracts, but it never reads bn/.bones, bone state, dependencies, or any of the 46 edited descriptions. Closing a KEEP bone or reverting bn-23g (or any other tracker acceptance edit) therefore leaves just m1-recut-check green. That means the machine evidence cannot enforce the bone acceptance that every open M1 bone matches the frozen contracts. Add a deterministic tracker projection/check (including all 55 states and the material acceptance markers/routes) plus a negative regression that mutates one projected bone.

[P2] Preserve the recorded adjudication result. The frozen taxonomy says the taxonomy is adjudicable and that only the ten-valid-session prerequisite failed (FAILURE-TAXONOMY.md:19-24,234-236; baseline-taxonomy-decision.md:17-29). Saying the invalid sessions made the taxonomy inadjudicable rewrites the experiment result and the reason no branch applied. State that the taxonomy was adjudicable but four invalid sessions left only 6/10 valid, and make the reconciliation gate assert this distinction so it cannot drift again.

Fixed: scripts/check-m1-recut.py now resolves the Maw default workspace and reads the live local tracker through bn list/show. It requires exactly the 55 manifest M1 IDs, every state open, the m1 label, exact parent/dependency anchors, and the SHA-256 of the complete M0.7 acceptance section for all 46 edited descriptions. bn-23g also has explicit semantic assertions for collection/existence leads, read-only ORACLE_UNAVAILABLE planning, exit 5 before traffic, and no promotion/negative. scripts/test-m1-recut.py mutates only deep-copied projections and proves closure, missing bones, dependency drift, each of the 46 acceptance bodies, and a coordinated bn-23g text/hash rollback fail. Focused gate, zero-cycle graph check, 55/55 live-open check, and full just check pass.

Fixed: plan revision 6 and the re-cut ADR now state that the four invalid sessions were categorized, the taxonomy was adjudicable for the six valid submissions, and the result was inconclusive solely because the preregistered ten-valid-session prerequisite failed. scourge.m1-recut.v1 records invalid_sessions=4, taxonomy_adjudicable=true, and failed_prerequisite=ten-valid-sessions; the reconciliation gate asserts the distinction and rejects inadjudicable wording. Focused and full just check pass.

data.reason: Fixed with live tracker validation, deterministic negative tests, and corrected adjudication wording; focused, graph, and full gates pass.
